text: Welcome.
It’s a pleasure to meet you.
I am Philemon,
a dweller between consciousness\nand unconsciousness.
And now, a simple test:
Can you state your name?
Splendid.
There aren’t many who can remember\ntheir identity when in this domain.
It seems you passed that test.
But tell me this:
are you aware of the many and varied\nselves you harbor within you?
The selves effused with divine love,
the self capable of demonic cruelty...
People live by wearing different masks.
Your current self may be only\none of those innumerable masks.
You, though... You have\na very firm grip on your identity.
I respect your strong will.\nIn return I grant this power -
Persona.
It is the power to summon\nthe selves within you,
the gods and the demons you harbor.
The time is soon\nwhen you will need this power.
Now you must return
to your proper time and place.
We meet again, my friends.
Are you used to your Personas now?
As you have seen for yourselves,\nevents are moving in an unexpected direction.
Only those with a strong will are capable\nof stopping the flow that has gone awry.
From here on, a number of paths\nwill present themselves to you.
Down each of them,\nyou will witness the karma of those you meet.
But whatever path you choose, remember\nthat the choice was yours and no one else’s.
How are you, friends?
Just as you thought,
this world is a counterfeit of your own.
It is this world where Kandori’s ambitions lie.
If you pursue him,
you will eventually discover\nthe nature of this world
and how to return to your home world.
Kandori has made his fortress on the east side\nof town, where he is searching for something.
Should it fall into his hands,\nthere will be no tomorrow for either world.
You must stop Kandori.
The first step is to use the subway\nterminal to reach the east side of town.
But, the gate has a guardian.
Look for the Expel Mirror.
Well done in returning here.
I see my faith in you was not misplaced.
The Alaya Cavern behind this shrine leads\nto the sea of all mankind’s souls.
All souls are born there\nand someday return there.
Maki Sonomura’s soul is about\nto return to that sea right now.
It calls for you and for her ideal self.
Now go!
Only those who have been\ncalled may enter that cavern.
Warp together to help the lost soul.
A moment, please.
You are angry and frustrated,
but that will not rescue your teacher.
There is only one way to do that:\nthe demon mirror.
It can remove the source of the mask’s curse.
However, the Snow Queen has shattered it.
The twelve shards are scattered\namongst three towers.
Take this mirror frame with you.
Fit the mirror shards you find into it.
If you gather enough shards\nto reflect your teacher,
she can be saved.
There isn’t much time left.
I pray for your success.
How are you doing, friends?
This is a world of dreams,
ruled by the Persona Hypnos\nof this tower’s master.
Hypnos is currently trapping people’s souls\nand confining them in the dream world.
Thus, this is a crossroad\nbetween the dream world and reality.
Either go to the dream world\nand awaken the people there
or continue forth and defeat Hypnos -
the choice is yours.
But remember:\nthere is a limit to the time you are given.
Nothing more need be said.
I’m sure you have all discovered\nby now your true selves.
The smiles you wear\nare no longer false masks.
You may find yourselves troubled\nor suffering or lost in the future,
but there is nothing to fear.
Look to your soul for your true self.
No matter what trials you may face,
that will be enough for you\nto weather the storm.
Now go forth
into your bright futures.
